messages.content: "請問你能幫我完成以下任務嗎？首先，我有兩組資料點：group1包含[12、15、18、22、25]，group2包含[20、23、26、29、32]。我想對這些組進行兩樣本的t-test，並假設它們具有相等的變異數。其次，我目前在麻州波士頓，我想吃一些壽司。你能找到最近有庭院和Wi-Fi的壽司餐廳嗎？最後，我最近開始繪畫作為一種嗜好，我想知道與此相關的常見個性特徵。你能檢索出喜歡繪畫的人的前5個個性特徵嗎？"

function.name: run_two_sample_ttest
function.description: Runs a two sample t-test for two given data groups. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

equal_variance.description: Assumption about whether the two samples have equal variance.

function.name: restaurant_search_find_closest
function.description: Locate the closest sushi restaurant based on certain criteria, such as the presence of a patio. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city, for instance Boston, MA

amenities.description: Preferred amenities in the restaurant. Default is none if not specified.

function.name: get_personality_traits
function.description: Retrieve the common personality traits of people based on their hobbies or activities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hobby.description: The hobby or activity of interest.

trait_count.description: The number of top traits to return, default is 5
